NewsArticle.Title: Maintenance
NewsArticle.Content: 01.25 11:00 p.m. pst Dark Ages will be unreachable for up to 30 minutes during ugrade to accomodate several more simultaneous players. Dark Ages servers are fast and stable; running well below maximum load with 0 server lag at peak volume. If you do experience latency, [test your connection.](http://www.darkages.com/support/trace_route.htm)
